main.description: How an author's profile page is arranged: which sections appear, in what order, and which collection is featured. Written by the account holder to their own repository.

profileType.description: Broad kind of profile, used to pick sensible default sections. Open-ended: an unknown value is preserved and falls back to the default layout.

sections.description: Ordered display sections. Order in this array is the display order.

featuredCollectionUri.description: Collection node pinned to the top of the profile.

createdAt.description: When this configuration was first created.

updatedAt.description: When this configuration was last changed.

section.description: One section of the profile layout.

kind.description: What the section shows. Open-ended so a section type can be added without invalidating existing records.

label.description: Heading shown for the section. Defaults to a label derived from `kind` when absent.

collectionUri.description: Collection this section draws from, where the kind supports it.

limit.description: Maximum items to display in this section.

visible.description: Whether the section is rendered. A hidden section keeps its configuration.
